name: IVR
tagline: International representation body for European inland waterway transport and shipping
hero_kpi_rationale: L'IVR est une organisation internationale sans but lucratif fondée en 1877 qui représente les intérêts du secteur européen de la navigation intérieure. L'absence de données financières quantifiables reflète sa nature institutionnelle. La participation au congrès annuel (225 participants en 2024) illustre son rôle de plateforme de coordination et de networking pour le secteur.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple European countries.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and international participation across 11 countries
kpis.description: The 2024 annual IVR Congress held in Frankfurt am Main (15-17 May 2024) attracted 225 participants from 11 different European countries, demonstrating robust industry engagement with the organization.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new loss prevention initiative with broad industry participation
kpis.description: The first-ever Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on 4 November 2024 gathered approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with member representation in IVR governance and activities.
kpis.signal: Pan-European reach demonstrating strong geographic diversification across the inland shipping sector
kpis.description: The IVR represents and coordinates with 11 different European countries in its annual congress and activities, reflecting its role as an international pan-European organization for inland waterway transport interests.
